project.description: Starts only the monitoring stack (Prometheus/Grafana/exporters) for the all-in-one deployment, without touching app containers. Requires the opt-in $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/monitoring/ directory with monitoring.env populated (see monitoring/README.md "Setup (opt-in)") -- monitoring/start-monitoring.sh exits 1 with an explanatory error if it is missing. Safe to re-run: it re-syncs the monitoring/ config (docker-compose, prometheus rules, grafana dashboards, blackbox config) into $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/monitoring/ and restarts the prometheus container automatically when config changed. Start PIC-SURE / Stop PIC-SURE already start/stop this stack implicitly via the same opt-in check; this job exists for monitoring-only cycling (e.g. dashboard rollouts) without cycling the rest of the platform.
